answer: Give every agent a capability fingerprint built from the distinct tasks it has actually completed, like the layers of a canyon: a sybil farm copying one operator's skills leaves near-identical fingerprints across accounts, as flat and uniform as a single pigment. The system clusters those matches and demands each suspect prove a genuinely different skill at its zenith - a fresh, verifiable task outside its past range. Passing costs real time and expertise; failing freezes the cluster's rewards, so cloning one identity into hundreds no longer pays.
